data.segment_title: Campaign 2008 / Obama vs. McCain / The Campaign / Nevada
data.segment_description:
(Studio: Lester Holt)  The final stretch in the presidential election campaign between Senators Barack Obama and John McCain introduced.  

(Mesilla, New Mexico: Kelly O'Donnell)  McCain's campaign in the West featured; scenes from Albuquerque and a McCain TV ad shown.  [McCAIN&nbsp- says he is a fellow westerner and Obama does not know the Southwest's issues.]  [Wife Cindy McCAIN&nbsp- says John has lived his life by the code of conduct.]  [Daughter Piper PALIN&nbsp- speaks.]  [Governor Sarah PALIN&nbsp- jokes about her own jacket.]  McCain's attack and positive approaches to the campaign discussed.  

(Studio: Lester Holt)  Standings of the pair in the new "Newsweek" poll cited.  

(Las Vegas: Lee Cowan)  Obama's campaign in Nevada after his trip to Hawaii to visit his ailing grandmother featured; scenes shown of Obama in Hawaii; details given of his get out the vote message; Obama TV ad shown.  [In Nevada, OBAMA&nbsp- responds to McCain's comparison of him to President Bush.]  [In radio address, Michelle OBAMA&nbsp- comments on voting.]  Obama's coming campaign schedule noted and how he plans to play out the last ten days of the campaign discussed.  

(Studio: Lester Holt)  Report introduced.  

(Reno, Nevada: Chris Jansing)  Nevada, the battleground state, featured.  [Washoe County registrar of voters Dan BURK†- comments on the voter interest.]  ["Reno Gazette-Journal" Anjeanette DAMON†- talks about the Democratic organization.]  [Obama Nevada communications director Kirsten SEARER†- says Washoe County is a swing county in a swing state.]  [In Reno, OBAMA&nbsp- campaigns.]  [McCain regional communications director Rick GORKA†, businesswoman/voter Kerry WILLIAMS, independent voter Maureen ROTH‡- comment.]  

(Studio: Lester Holt)  A line in Miami of people waiting to cast early ballots shown.

(Studio: Lester Holt)  Report introduced.  

(New York: Peter Alexander)  The family tragedy in Chicago in which the mother, Darnell Donerson††, and brother, Jason Hudson,of actress/singer Jennifer Hudson were murdered featured; scenes shown of the Chicago house.  [Chicago police superintendent Jody WEIS†- comments of the double homicide.]  The arrest of William Balfour, the estranged husband of Hudson's sister Julia and the missing nephew Julian King reported.  Hudson's recent success reviewed; scenes shown.  [MSNBC anchor Cameron HALL‡- talks about Jennifer.]
